test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Eight friends, Hari, Ganpati, Falak, Ekta, Janak, Rohit, Mangesh and Tony, are sitting around a round table, facing the centre of the table but not necessarily in the same order. Janak is sitting third to the right of Mangesh, who is not an immediate neighbour of either Falak or Tony. Falak is sitting second to the left of Tony, who is sitting third to the left of Hari. Ganpati is sitting fourth to the right of Tony. Ekta is sitting second to the left of Hari.

Who is second to the right of Janak?
solution:
Given: Eight friends, Hari, Ganpati, Falak, Ekta, Janak, Rohit, Mangesh and Tony, are sitting around a round table, facing the centre.

1) Falak is sitting second to the left of **Tony, who** is sitting third to the left of Hari.

2) Ekta is sitting second to the left of Hari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f88d984c67bd7a9c780d56c1f585ff9f30e19c2ef3019a16225917647e3e753.png] 

3) Ganpati is sitting fourth to the right of Tony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61192eb87a0ad59b92750a9e905804d1904047d3ccfd746292c86eea2f6a5722.png] 

4) Janak is sitting third to the right of **Mangesh, who** is not an immediate neighbour of either Falak or Tony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0003c6e2b6cbb6ab8b9fefcdc93cd09a72fdf5bce884cee03a5b7515ca8ea13b.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b5e8772d3a74f2a9a192e60d3ec06cd481b37186d5e019218c51f67f563770e.png] 

So, **Rohit **is second to the right of Janak.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Rohit**".
